name: TerraVision
description: Generates official-style AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud architecture diagrams from plain-language descriptions or Terraform, and Terraform from designs, via MCP or CLI, for cloud engineers.

skills.name: Diagram from Description
skills.description: Draws a cloud architecture diagram with official provider icons from a plain-language description in an AI assistant.

skills.name: Diagram from Terraform
skills.description: Renders the resources a Terraform project or plan deploys as a nested VPC, subnet, and zone diagram.

skills.name: Terraform from Design
skills.description: Writes Terraform for a designed architecture and checks it by redrawing the generated code.

skills.name: CI/CD Diagram Updates
skills.description: Regenerates architecture diagrams in CI/CD pipelines so they stay current with the code.
